title: Letter to Mrs. Bixby
author: Abraham Lincoln
rights: 美国：1864 年出版；中国：作者1865 年去世，保护期已满
intro: 这封信以林肯名义写给波士顿的毕克斯贝夫人，安慰她据称失去五个儿子的丧子之痛（人数本身也有争议）。信件真伪存在争议，有一种常见说法认为是林肯的秘书约翰·海伊所写。信中措辞庄重、有礼，多用长句与抽象名词，朗读时要读出悲悯而克制的语气。
tips: 信的语气庄重克制，长句之间的停顿要稍长。
“I pray that our heavenly Father” 是祈祷语气，宜放慢、略降低音量。

segments.text: I have been shown in the files of the War Department a statement of the Adjutant-General of Massachusetts that you are the mother of five sons who have died gloriously on the field of battle.
I feel how weak and fruitless must be any words of mine which should attempt to beguile you from the grief of a loss so overwhelming.
But I cannot refrain from tendering to you the consolation that may be found in the thanks of the Republic they died to save.
I pray that our heavenly Father may assuage the anguish of your bereavement, and leave you only the cherished memory of the loved and lost,
and the solemn pride that must be yours to have laid so costly a sacrifice upon the altar of freedom. Yours very sincerely and respectfully, Abraham Lincoln.
